description: A task to help students understand the concept of left and right.
speech_start: Welcome to the Left Right Identification task.

engage.speech_start: Hello children. Today we are going to learn about left and right.
engage.speech_end: Can you remember which side is your left hand?
engage.description: Connect with prior knowledge. show video if needed. not compulsory.

explore.description: If needed only show the video, its not compulsory, Students observe objects and identify directions.
explore.activity_description: Students raise their left hand and right hand and show to the teacher. (Kinestatic activity with teacher guidance)
explore.speech_end: Great. Now let's learn more together.

explain.speech_start: Left means this side of your body and right means the other side.
explain.speech_end: Now you know what left and right means.
explain.description: Robot explains the concept using examples.

elaborate.task_description: Which image shows the left hand?
